title: core package ships only the minimal config wirer not the end to end installer
summary: @zonoid/core's vendored tarball ships bin/install.js (the `zonoid-install` bin), which ONLY writes .mcp.json + .claude/settings.json. The end-to-end installer is a SEPARATE package, @zonoid/cli (packages/cli/bin/zonoid.js, run as `npx @zonoid/cli init`), and @zonoid/core's package.json `files` list EXCLUDES `packages/` (verified: files includes packages/? false), so the full installer is never present in a repo that vendors core (observed in HY_world). Critically, init() DELEGATES the Claude config wiring back to bin/install.js (checkClaudeWiring spawns `node bin/install.js --workspace <cwd>`), so bin/install.js is a SUB-STEP of init, not a peer — running it standalone yields 1 of 8 install sections. Missing when only bin/install.js runs: skills symlink into ~/.claude/skills, pre-push test guard, CLAUDE.md orchestrator-section merge, daemon workspace registration, git identity, graph auto-commit hook, embedding warmup. Onboarding is a third path entirely (`npx @zonoid/cli onboard` subcommand), never part of init.
